info.name: Insurance Policy & Claim Management System — AUDITED
info.description: Complete, audited, executable collection built from backend source code. Roles: ADMIN | INTERNAL_STAFF | CUSTOMER. Auth: JWT Bearer (saved automatically on login). Version: 2026-08. Base URL: {{baseUrl}} default http://localhost:8080

item.name: 00 — Authentication
item.description: All auth endpoints. Run Register -> Verify OTP -> Login in sequence. Login scripts auto-save role tokens.

request.description: Registers a new CUSTOMER account. Account is locked until OTP verification. Sends OTP to email and phone.
Verifies both email OTP and phone OTP. Both are required. Activates the customer account.
Resends OTP to inactive accounts. Only works if the account is not yet active.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', d.accessToken); }

request.description: Authenticates Admin. Saves accessToken to adminToken variable. Refresh token is stored in HttpOnly cookie automatically.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('staffToken', d.accessToken); }

request.description: Authenticates INTERNAL_STAFF. Saves to staffToken. Switch to staffToken in collection auth when testing staff endpoints.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('customerToken', d.accessToken); }

request.description: Authenticates CUSTOMER. Saves to customerToken.
Silently refreshes the access token using the HttpOnly refresh_token cookie. In Postman, requires cookie jar to be enabled. Returns new accessToken.
Sends password reset OTP to both email and phone. Always returns success (no user enumeration). Next: Reset Password.
Resets password using OTPs. Increments tokenVersion, invalidating all existing sessions.
Revokes refresh token in DB and blacklists current access token in Redis. Clears the HttpOnly cookie.
Revokes ALL refresh tokens for the authenticated user across all devices. Requires valid access token.

item.name: 01 — Admin — User Management
item.description: Endpoints for managing all system users (ADMIN only). Create staff, activate/deactivate accounts, list users.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', String(d.id)); }

request.description: Creates INTERNAL_STAFF account. productSpeciality enum: HEALTH, MOTOR, LIFE, TRAVEL, PROPERTY. Sends OTP for activation.
Returns all users (no pagination). Role: ADMIN only.
Returns a specific user. Role: ADMIN only.
Paginated users with optional filtering by role, isActive, fullName, email.
Manually activates a user account. Role: ADMIN only.
Deactivates a user account, preventing future logins. Role: ADMIN only.

item.name: 02 — Admin — Insurance Products
item.description: Manage the top-level insurance product categories (HEALTH, MOTOR, LIFE, etc.). ADMIN only for write operations.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('productId', String(d.id)); }

body.raw: {"productName": "Health Shield", "productType": "HEALTH", "description": "Comprehensive health coverage for individuals and families.", "activeStatus": true}

request.description: Creates a new insurance product category. productType enum: HEALTH, MOTOR, LIFE, TRAVEL, PROPERTY. Saves productId.

body.raw: {"productName": "Health Shield Pro", "productType": "HEALTH", "description": "Updated comprehensive health coverage.", "activeStatus": true}

request.description: Full update of product details. Role: ADMIN only.
Retrieves a specific product. Accessible by all authenticated roles.
Lists all active products. Used by customers for product discovery. Accessible by all roles.
Paginated list of all products. Roles: ADMIN, INTERNAL_STAFF.
Reactivates a deactivated product. Note: URL path is /activate not /active.
Marks product as inactive. Plans under it can no longer be purchased.

item.name: 03 — Admin — Policy Plans (Wizard)
item.description: Create and manage policy plans. The wizard creates plan + coverage options + pricing rule in one call. ADMIN only for write operations.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.plan && d.plan.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('planId', String(d.plan.id)); }

body.raw: {"planDetails": {"productId": 1, "planName": "Health Premium", "allowedDurations": [1, 2, 3, 5, 10], "supportedPremiumType": "ANNUAL", "termsAndConditions": "This plan covers hospitalization and surgical expenses up to the selected coverage amount.", "activeStatus": true}, "coverageOptions": [{"coverageAmount": 100000, "label": "1 Lakh Cover", "displayOrder": 1, "activeStatus": true}, {"coverageAmount": 500000, "label": "5 Lakh Cover", "displayOrder": 2, "activeStatus": true}, {"coverageAmount": 1000000, "label": "10 Lakh Cover", "displayOrder": 3, "activeStatus": true}], "pricingRule": {"baseRiskRate": 0.005, "processingFee": 500.00, "gst": 18.0, "effectiveFrom": "2026-01-01T00:00:00", "effectiveTo": "2027-12-31T23:59:59", "remarks": "Initial pricing rule for Health Premium plan"}}

request.description: Creates plan with coverage options and pricing rule in one atomic call. supportedPremiumType enum: ANNUAL, MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, SEMI_ANNUAL. Saves planId.

body.raw: {"productId": 1, "planName": "Health Premium Updated", "allowedDurations": [1, 2, 5, 10], "supportedPremiumType": "ANNUAL", "termsAndConditions": "Updated terms and conditions for the health premium plan.", "activeStatus": true}

request.description: Updates plan basic details only. Coverage options and pricing rules are managed separately.
Retrieves full plan details including coverage options. All authenticated roles.
Lists all active plans across all products. All authenticated roles.
Lists active plans for a specific product. Use after selecting a product. All authenticated roles.
Paginated plans with rich filtering. Roles: ADMIN, INTERNAL_STAFF.
Makes a plan available for purchase.
Prevents plan from being purchased. Does not affect existing policies.

item.name: 04 — Admin — Coverage Options
item.description: Manage individual coverage tiers for a plan. All endpoints under /api/admin/policy-plans/{planId}/coverage-options. ADMIN only.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('optionId', String(d.id)); }

request.description: Adds a new coverage tier to a plan. Saves optionId.
Updates an existing coverage option.
Lists all coverage options (active and inactive) for a plan.
Makes this coverage tier available for quoting.
Hides this coverage tier from quoting.
Permanently removes a coverage option.
Replaces all coverage options for a plan in one operation.

item.name: 05 — Admin — Pricing Rules
item.description: Manage dynamic pricing rules for plans. ADMIN only. Each plan should have one ACTIVE pricing rule at a time.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('ruleId', String(d.id)); }

request.description: Creates a new pricing rule for a plan. Saves ruleId.
Updates an existing pricing rule.
Retrieves a specific pricing rule.
Lists pricing rules with optional filtering by planId and status.
Returns the currently active pricing rule for a plan. Used before quoting to verify pricing is configured.
Returns the audit log of changes to a pricing rule.
Activates a pricing rule. Only one rule per plan can be active at a time.
Deactivates a pricing rule.
Permanently removes a pricing rule.
Preview the calculated premium without creating a quote. Useful for admin price testing.

item.name: 06 — Customer — Profile
item.description: Customer profile management. POST creates the profile; PUT updates it; GET /profile returns own profile.

request.description: Creates customer profile for authenticated CUSTOMER. Profile is created automatically on registration; use PUT to update.
Returns the profile of the authenticated customer.
Updates customer profile. Set customerId variable from the profile response.
Retrieves a customer by ID. Roles: ADMIN, INTERNAL_STAFF.
Lists all customer profiles. Roles: ADMIN, INTERNAL_STAFF.
Paginated customers with optional geo-filtering. Roles: ADMIN, INTERNAL_STAFF.

item.name: 07 — Customer — Generate Quote
item.description: Generate a premium quote before purchasing a policy. The quoteId from this step is required for purchase.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.quoteId) pm.collectionVariables.set('quoteId', String(d.quoteId)); }

request.description: Calculates premium for selected plan/coverage/duration. Returns quoteId required for purchase. premiumType enum: ANNUAL, MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, SEMI_ANNUAL. Saves quoteId.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.quoteId) pm.collectionVariables.set('quoteId', String(d.quoteId)); }

request.description: Admin/Staff generates a quote on behalf of a customer. Requires customerId. Saves quoteId.

item.name: 08 — Customer — Policy Purchase
item.description: Purchase a policy using a quoteId. Quote must be PENDING (not expired or used). After purchase, make payment to activate.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('policyId', String(d.id)); }

request.description: Creates policy in PENDING_PAYMENT status. quoteId is required (from Generate Quote). paymentReferenceId is optional. Saves policyId.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('policyId', String(d.id)); }

request.description: Admin/Staff issues a policy manually for a customer. Requires both customerId and quoteId (not planId). Saves policyId.
Returns paginated list of all policies for the authenticated customer.
Returns details of a specific policy. All authenticated roles.
Returns all claims associated with a policy. All authenticated roles.
Returns policies for a specific customer. Roles: ADMIN, INTERNAL_STAFF.
Paginated list of all system policies with optional filtering. Roles: ADMIN, INTERNAL_STAFF.
Cancels an active or pending policy. Roles: ADMIN, INTERNAL_STAFF.

item.name: 09 — Payments
item.description: Record and view premium payments. POST /api/payments records a payment and automatically activates PENDING policies on SUCCESS.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('paymentId', String(d.id)); }

request.description: Records a successful payment. Policy moves from PENDING_PAYMENT to ACTIVE automatically. paymentStatus: SUCCESS or FAILED. Saves paymentId.
Records a failed payment. Policy remains in PENDING_PAYMENT status.
Retrieves a specific payment record. All authenticated roles.
Returns all payment records for the authenticated customer. Role: CUSTOMER.
Returns payment history for a specific policy owned by the authenticated customer. Role: CUSTOMER.
Returns all payments for a policy. Roles: ADMIN, INTERNAL_STAFF.
Paginated all payments with rich filtering. Roles: ADMIN, INTERNAL_STAFF.

item.name: 10 — Claims
item.description: Full claim lifecycle. Customer raises -> Staff reviews -> Staff recommends -> Admin decides. Flow: SUBMITTED -> UNDER_REVIEW -> ASSIGNED -> RECOMMENDED_FOR_APPROVAL/REJECTION -> APPROVED/REJECTED.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('claimId', String(d.id)); }

request.description: Raises a claim with supporting documents. Content-Type must be multipart/form-data. 'claim' part is JSON. 'files' part is one or more files. Saves claimId.
Returns all claims filed by the authenticated customer.
Paginated all claims with filtering. Roles: ADMIN, INTERNAL_STAFF.
Returns full claim details. All authenticated roles.
Returns the complete status change audit trail for a claim. All authenticated roles.

item.name: Move Claim to Under Review (Internal Staff)

request.description: Staff picks up a SUBMITTED claim for review. Status: SUBMITTED -> UNDER_REVIEW. Role: INTERNAL_STAFF only.
Staff assigns an UNDER_REVIEW claim to themselves. Status: UNDER_REVIEW -> ASSIGNED. Role: INTERNAL_STAFF only.

body.raw: {"recommendedStatus": "RECOMMENDED_FOR_APPROVAL", "remarks": "All documents verified. Claim is legitimate and within coverage limit."}

request.description: Staff recommends claim for approval. Status: ASSIGNED -> RECOMMENDED_FOR_APPROVAL. Role: INTERNAL_STAFF only.

body.raw: {"recommendedStatus": "RECOMMENDED_FOR_REJECTION", "remarks": "Incident date does not match medical records provided."}

request.description: Staff recommends claim for rejection. Status: ASSIGNED -> RECOMMENDED_FOR_REJECTION. Role: INTERNAL_STAFF only.

body.raw: {"recommendedStatus": "APPROVED", "remarks": "Claim approved after final review. Amount will be disbursed within 7 working days."}

request.description: Admin makes final approval decision. Status: RECOMMENDED_FOR_APPROVAL -> APPROVED. Role: ADMIN only.
Admin makes final rejection decision. Status: RECOMMENDED_FOR_REJECTION -> REJECTED. Role: ADMIN only.
Upload additional supporting documents to an existing claim. Note: URL is /upload/{{claimId}} (slash before claimId).

item.name: 11 — Public
item.description: Unauthenticated public endpoints. No auth required.

request.description: Returns live platform statistics (total policies, claims, customers). Falls back to default numbers if DB is empty. No authentication required.
